text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I heard you traveled to a faraway 
racetrack, Orfe. How was the trip? You 
didn't feel too cramped on the train, did 
you?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
All went smoothly. The seats around me 
were vacant as well, making for a 
comfortable journey.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I see... That's good to hear. Being able 
to relax while traveling is the best, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "...I see. So it was my sister's doing."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
No. Even if I were to ask, you wouldn't 
tell me, would you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, is there anything on your mind 
regarding the trip? Was there anything you 
found inconvenient?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's see— ...Ah. The seats should be 
slightly wider.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—! Right, so that's how it is. I'll be 
sure to remember that, just in case... 
Heheh.
